evidence.description: Public static let shared instance combined with a public init() method.

candidates.explanation: The class uses a shared singleton instance but also provides a public initializer, allowing for multiple instances to be created, which can lead to inconsistent state in a singleton-patterned design.
candidates.title: Public Initializer with Singleton

evidence.description: DateFormatter is instantiated on every access of the localizedMonthAndYear property.

candidates.explanation: The DateFormatter is instantiated inside a computed property. Creating a DateFormatter is an expensive operation; it should be reused or stored as a static/private property to improve performance.
candidates.title: Expensive Object Creation in Computed Property

evidence.description: Mixing JSONSerialization.jsonObject and JSONDecoder.decode for the same data source.

candidates.explanation: The code performs manual JSON parsing using JSONSerialization to extract keys and then uses JSONDecoder to decode the final object. This is redundant and inefficient as JSONDecoder can handle the entire structure.
candidates.title: Redundant JSON Parsing Logic

candidates.explanation: The code uses a hardcoded time interval for the default value of latestMonth, which makes the code less readable and harder to maintain compared to using a specific date or a more descriptive constant.
candidates.title: Magic Number for Date Initialization
